events.title: A practical performance kit becomes available

variants.text:
The Performance Kit gathers what a prepared piece needs: props, a simple instrument, or costume elements within the current scene. It does not expand general inventory or define a universal list of artistic disciplines.

Having the kit means a specific piece can be prepared without a last-minute improvised substitute. It is evidence of Artist-local readiness rather than an automatic bonus to every performance.

choices.label: Keep working without it
choices.text: Formal Attire, Performance Kit, and Invitation Token change only narrow Artist options and evidence. They create no general status, fame system, patron currency, contest bonus, or new Palace rule.

events.title: Formal Artist House attire becomes available

variants.text:
Formal attire helps fit the expectations of a specific performance or reception. It does not make the heroine a member of a higher social circle, guarantee respect, or open the Palace.

Choosing formal attire means preparing the visual language of one evening: degree of formality, freedom of movement, and appropriateness. It is an Artist-local capability rather than permanent character status.

events.title: An Artist House invitation token can be carried

variants.text:
An Invitation Token confirms that a specific invitation or contact exists and can be presented in an Artist context. It is not a universal pass and does not satisfy the Palace unlock.

Even with an Invitation Token, the route remains narrow: show which invitation the token belongs to and what the specific event expects. The token is not a universal pass.
